name: Chamomile
short: Only mild adverse events in a review of 12 trials. A warfarin review lists chamomile tea among items with increased bleeding risk; a case report describes anaphylaxis to chamomile tea.
text: In a systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 randomised trials of chamomile for anxiety and sleep, mild adverse events were reported by only three trials. A systematic review of warfarin interactions listed chamomile tea among the foods and herbs for which healthcare professionals should be aware of an increased risk of bleeding, and advised patients to seek advice from their healthcare professionals when starting any new herb, food or supplement. A published case report (title only; no abstract available) describes an anaphylactic reaction to chamomile tea in a patient with mugwort pollinosis.
